notes:
I found three Oakville options for a preschooler. I couldn't confirm class days or times for any of them. Each pick below comes off the operator's own page.


The YMCA of Oakville runs Preschool Swim Lessons for ages 3 to 5.
 
Its swim lessons run in 12-week sessions with a one-week break between them.
 I found no days, times or price for the fall session.


Goldfish Swim School's group lessons are $32.50 a lesson for ages 4 months to 12 years, in 30-minute classes.
 
A $30 annual membership fee applies.
 
It is at 1130 Eighth Line, Unit 17.
 I found no class days or times on its pages.


The Town of Oakville teaches lessons under the Lifesaving Society's Swim for Life program.
 Its pages mention preschool levels but give no age range. 
The Town's booking page said fall registration opened Tuesday, August 11 at 7 a.m.
 That date has passed. I couldn't read the current schedule or prices, which sit behind the Town's registration system.
